body: Worker rule (Termal::BarA1, from Fable2 #421/#425, 2026-10-19 08:05Z, my own slip on w-4d6283a1f1f5 GREEN-3). After a focused run, foreground ones included, run NO commands and make NO edits in that root until a closing checkpoint has settled the run's host record; end the turn first. I ran two granted foreground runs (both failed on test defects), then edited and refroze GREEN-4 in the SAME turn. That risks the host recording the runs as refused or unsettled instead of failed, and for a passing run it would void the credit. Do this instead: report END with counts and classification, end the turn, and edit only on the next wake. Also: engram add moves session focus to the new item, and credit follows focus, so re-claim the working item immediately after filing a follow-up.
